legacyPatterns.message: Surface still renders one-off inline chart functions instead of adopting dashboard-kit chart primitives.
Surface still renders one-off depth chart functions instead of adopting LiquidityDepthChart or the static chart-surface contract.
Production-facing surfaces should not present real data as prototype preview copy.
Visual selection bridge must be development-only and blocked from production hosts.
Production dashboards should not embed another full dashboard shell; decompose promoted prototypes into shell, page content, components, and route config.
Production navigation should not link directly to prototype gallery pages.
Active prototype HTML routes should be dev review or compatibility routes, not primary production operator paths.
Surface uses local chart-card styling; confirm it is backed by dashboard-kit chart surface classes.
